prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Carmen, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just heard from a contact at the council office that they’re finally starting to fine anyone who leaves bins on the sidewalk after 8am next month. It’s about time they actually enforced some rules around here."
text: I just heard from my contact at the council office that they’re finally starting to fine anyone who leaves bins on the sidewalk after 8am starting March 1st. Even Mr. Henderson down the street said he’s already received a warning!
